lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kee prabh benatee har bhaavai bakhas milaai ||41||
lines.translation: Nanak offers this prayer: O Lord God, please forgive me, and unite me with Yourself. ||41||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਝੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man aavan jaan na sujhaee naa sujhai darabaar ||
lines.translation: The mortal being does not understand the comings and goings of reincarnation; he does not see the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪਲੇਟਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohi paletiaa a(n)tar agiaan gubaar ||
lines.translation: He is wrapped up in emotional attachment and Maya, and within his being is the darkness of ignorance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਬ ਨਰੁ ਸੁਤਾ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tab nar sutaa jaagiaa sir da(n)d lagaa bahu bhaar ||
lines.translation: The sleeping person wakes, only when he is hit on the head by a heavy club.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾਂ ਕਰਾਂ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਸੇ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukhaa(n) karaa(n) upar har chetiaa se paain mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs dwell upon the Lord; they find the door of salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਓਹਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਸਭ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਤਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap ohi udhare sabh kuta(n)b tare paravaar ||42||
lines.translation: O Nanak, they themselves are saved, and all their relatives are carried across as well. ||42||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਆ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad marai so muaa jaapai ||
lines.translation: Whoever dies in the Word of the Shabad, is known to be truly dead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee har ras dhraapai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the mortal is satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har daragahi gur sabad sinjaapai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is recognized in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਮੁਆ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai muaa hai sabh koi ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, everyone is dead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਮੁਆ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh muaa apunaa janam khoi ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh dies; his life is wasted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam na chetahi a(n)t dukh roi ||
lines.translation: Those who do not remember the Name of the Lord, shall cry in pain in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karataa kare s hoi ||43||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whatever the Creator Lord does, comes to pass. ||43||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਢੇ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh budhe kade naahee jinhaa a(n)tar surat giaan ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs never grow old; within them is intuitive understanding and spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa har gun ravahi a(n)tar sahaj dhiaan ||
lines.translation: They chant the Praises of the Lord, forever and ever; deep within, they intuitively meditate on the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਰਹਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi sadaa ana(n)d bibek rahahi dukh sukh ek samaan ||
lines.translation: They dwell forever in blissful knowledge of the Lord; they look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨਾ ਨਦਰੀ ਇਕੋ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨੁ ॥੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: tinaa nadaree iko aaiaa sabh aatam raam pachhaan ||44||
lines.translation: They see the One Lord in all, and realize the Lord, the Supreme Soul of all. ||44||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਸਮਾਨਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh baalak biradh samaan hai jinhaa a(n)tar har surat naahee ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are like stupid children; they do not keep the Lord in their thoughts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਸਭ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੈ ਜਾਂਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: vich haumai karam kamaavade sabh dharam raai kai jaa(n)hee ||
lines.translation: They do all their deeds in egotism, and they must answer to the Righteous Judge of Dharma.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਛੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hachhe niramale gur kai sabad subhaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukhs are good and immaculately pure; they are embellished and exalted with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਮੈਲੁ ਪਤੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa mail pata(n)g na lagaee j chalan satigur bhaai ||
lines.translation: Not even a tiny bit of filth sticks to them; they walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh jooth na utarai je sau dhovan paai ||
lines.translation: The filth of the manmukhs is not washed away, even if they wash hundreds of times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh melian gur kai a(n)k samaai ||45||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are united with the Lord; they merge into the Guru's Being. ||45||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਕੇਹਾ ਸਿਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: buraa kare s kehaa sijhai ||
lines.translation: How can someone do bad things, and still live with himself?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੈ ਰੋਹਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਦਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanai rohi aape hee dajhai ||
lines.translation: By his own anger, he only burns himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਕਮਲਾ ਰਗੜੈ ਲੁਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kamalaa ragaRai lujhai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh drives himself crazy with worries and stubborn struggles.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hoi tis sabh kichh sujhai ||
lines.translation: But those who become Gurmukh understand everything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲੁਝੈ ॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh man siu lujhai ||46||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh struggles with his own mind. ||46||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕੀਤੋ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa satigur purakh na sevio sabad na keeto veechaar ||
lines.translation: Those who do not serve the True Guru, the Primal Being, and do not reflect upon the Word of the Shabad

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਮਾਣਸ ਜੂਨਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਪਸੂ ਢੋਰ ਗਾਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi maanas joon na aakheean pasoo dhor gaavaar ||
lines.translation: - do not call them human beings; they are just animals and stupid beasts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa a(n)tar giaan na dhiaan hai har sau preet na piaar ||
lines.translation: They have no spiritual wisdom or meditation within their beings; they are not in love with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਮਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mue vikaar mahi mar ja(n)mahi vaaro vaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die in evil and corruption; they die and are reborn, again and again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevadiaa no milai s jeevade har jagajeevan ur dhaar ||
lines.translation: They alone live, who join with the living; enshrine the Lord, the Lord of Life, within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh sohane tit sachai darabaar ||47||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs look beautiful in that Court of the True Lord. ||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar har saajiaa har vasai jis naal ||
lines.translation: The Lord built the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; the Lord dwells within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਰਜਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee har paaiaa maaiaa moh parajaal ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord; my emotional attachment to Maya has been burnt away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਹੈ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ma(n)dar vasat anek hai nav nidh naam samaal ||
lines.translation: Countless things are in the Harimandir, the Temple of the Lord; contemplate the Naam, and the nine treasures will be yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan bhagava(n)tee naanakaa jinaa guramukh ladhaa har bhaal ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that happy soul-bride, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, seeks and finds the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee gaR ma(n)dar khojiaa har hiradai paaiaa naal ||48||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, one searches the temple of the body-fortress, and finds the Lord within the heart. ||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਅਤਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਲੋਭ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh dah dis phir rahe at tisanaa lobh vikaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs wander lost in the ten directions, led by intense desire, greed and corruption.
